business_problem: IBM’s CIO organization needed to collapse multiple operational data lakes into a single governed platform so teams could access more data, reduce duplication and standardize controls across infrastructure, application and enterprise-tool data.
solution_summary: The IBM CIO organization implemented an I&T Data Platform centered on IBM watsonx.data to consolidate fragmented operational IT data. Before the program, the organization stored information about applications, devices, networking, infrastructure and enterprise tools across seven different data lakes, each with inconsistent governance and overlapping ETL. The target platform combined IBM watsonx.data, IBM watsonx.ai, IBM Cognos Analytics and IBM Knowledge Catalog to create a unified hub for ingestion, governance, analytics and AI-driven insight. Data is loaded from legacy sources into the centralized platform, cataloged for controlled access, analyzed through Cognos dashboards and explored with watsonx.ai-driven machine learning. By replacing isolated repositories with one shared environment, the CIO team reduced data redundancy, lowered legacy costs and created a single source of truth that can scale further as new operational domains are onboarded.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Serves as the central data platform that consolidates operational data from legacy lakes.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Applies machine learning and AI-driven analysis to the consolidated operational data.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Delivers reporting and dashboards over the unified operational data set.

solution_components.name: IBM Knowledge Catalog
solution_components.role: Provides governance and controlled access to the centralized data assets.

data_flow: Operational IT data from legacy systems is ingested into watsonx.data, cataloged and governed through Knowledge Catalog, analyzed with watsonx.ai and surfaced through Cognos Analytics for self-service decision-making and reporting.
business_outcome: IBM reduced legacy data costs, lowered redundancy and created a single governed data foundation that supports large-scale operational analytics and AI use cases.
